final: WITH lab_ratios AS (SELECT ID, CASE WHEN HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT > 0 THEN HGB / HCT ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM Laboratory), patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ratio) AS patient_avg FROM lab_ratios WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), first_overall AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS first_avg FROM patient_avgs), filtered_first AS (SELECT p.ID, p.patient_avg, (p.patient_avg - f.first_avg) AS diff_from_first FROM patient_avgs p CROSS JOIN first_overall f WHERE p.patient_avg > f.first_avg AND f.first_avg IS NOT NULL), second_overall AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS second_avg FROM filtered_first), filtered_second AS (SELECT ff.ID, ff.patient_avg, ff.diff_from_first, (ff.patient_avg - so.second_avg) AS diff_from_second FROM filtered_first ff CROSS JOIN second_overall so WHERE ff.patient_avg > so.second_avg AND so.second_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS avg_patient_avg, AVG(diff_from_first) AS avg_diff_first, AVG(diff_from_second) AS avg_diff_second FROM filtered_second    -- yields one row: (0.3366026077113523, 0.008324048128962943, 0.0031174156204581086)
